clue.text: Watch for Hun!

parts.note: the three letters of this word make up the first half of the word for a hunting horse or pocket watch with a covered face

explanation.surface: A warning cry to keep an eye out for an invading barbarian.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Hun' as an instruction: it is half of the word HUNTER. A half-hunter is a pocket watch whose lid has a small window so the time shows without opening it.
explanation.definitionFit: A half-hunter is a type of pocket watch with a glazed opening in its cover, so it is a kind of timepiece.

clue.text: Type of porcelain food container

definitions.meaning: ... china is very thin, delicate porcelain
the shell is the casing that holds the egg, itself a food

explanation.definitionFit: Eggshell names both a fine translucent china and the natural case that holds an egg's contents.

clue.text: Prisoner catches general unaware

annotationWithheld.why: Prisoner catches general unaware (6): ASLEEP needs LEE inside ASP, but no sense of 'Prisoner' gives ASP and no other parse is found; a word seems misprinted

clue.text: Spends money on extras, we hear

indicators.note: signals that the word spoken should be written as one sounding the same

parts.note: in cricket, byes are extras: runs scored without the ball touching the bat

explanation.surface: Someone splashes out on additional items, so people report.
explanation.walkthrough: Byes are runs credited to the batting side in cricket when the ball passes the batsman and wicketkeeper; they count among the 'extras'.
explanation.definitionFit: To spend money on something is to purchase it, a plain synonym.

clue.text: It will provide inside information, which needs digesting

definitions.text: It will provide inside information, which needs digesting

parts.words: It will provide inside information, which needs digesting
parts.note: describes a drink swallowed before an X-ray so the gut shows up, read as if it were gossip or secrets to be absorbed

explanation.surface: A source of confidential tips that takes some time to take in.
explanation.definitionFit: A barium meal is swallowed so that X-rays reveal the inside of the digestive tract, literally information about the inside.

clue.text: Exquisite food

definitions.meaning: as a noun, an exquisite is a dandy; in eighteenth-century England a fashionable fop was called a ...

explanation.definitionFit: Macaroni was the name for an affected eighteenth-century dandy as well as being the familiar tube-shaped pasta.

clue.text: A broken romance?

parts.note: reads like a failed love affair, but means a love story split into instalments

explanation.surface: A relationship that has fallen apart.
explanation.definitionFit: A serial is a story published or broadcast in parts, so a romantic tale told that way is broken into episodes.

clue.text: Snick a boundary

definitions.meaning: in cricket, a snick is a slight deflection of the ball off the side of the bat

explanation.definitionFit: Edge means both a faint touch off the bat in cricket and the border or rim of something.

clue.text: Put in a drink, it knocked Argonauts out

indicators.note: with 'out', says the letters of the heroes' name are battered into a new order
completes 'knocked out', the instruction to rearrange the word between them

explanation.surface: A spiked drink flattened Jason's crew of Greek heroes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked' and 'out' together signal the anagram, split around the fodder word.
explanation.definitionFit: Angostura bitters are a few drops added to cocktails, so they are something put in a drink.

clue.text: Winning article by school principal

parts.note: 'a' is the indefinite article
the head is the head teacher of a school

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece about a successful headteacher.
explanation.definitionFit: Being ahead in a contest means being in front, so currently leading.

clue.text: Set off among supporters for ties

indicators.note: says the rearranged letters sit within the word for supporters

parts.note: fans support a team

indicators.note: the word set is thrown off its order, so its letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Football fans carry off a set of team ties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ties' looks like a noun for neckwear, but it is the verb; 'off' is the anagram signal and 'among' the container.
explanation.definitionFit: To fasten is to secure or bind, so ties in its verb sense is a synonym.

clue.text: Picture held in fancy

indicators.note: the outer word holds the small word inside it

parts.note: an image is a picture

explanation.surface: A painting kept in a whimsical style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Picture' looks like the definition, but it supplies IMAGE, which holds IN.
explanation.definitionFit: To fancy something is to suppose or conjure it up in the mind, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Exhaust advice about umbrellas in the rain

definitions.text: advice about umbrellas in the rain
definitions.meaning: a shower calls for brollies to be opened and put to work, so the advice is to raise them

explanation.definitionFit: To exhaust a supply is to consume all of it, and the phrase also sounds like a command to open umbrellas.

clue.text: The vulgar crowd we all have to suffer

definitions.meaning: the ordinary mass of people, the common herd

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both the general mass of ordinary people and the shared fate that befalls everyone.

clue.text: Go over to settle a quarrel with a grump

parts.note: to cross is to go over
to patch up is to mend a quarrel

explanation.surface: Someone tries to make peace with a bad-tempered person.
explanation.definitionFit: A crosspatch is an irritable, bad-tempered person, someone grouchy.

clue.text: Disciplinarian marks a test roughly

indicators.note: a rough approximation of the order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A strict teacher grades an exam harshly.
explanation.definitionFit: A taskmaster is someone who imposes heavy work and strict rules, a stern enforcer.

clue.text: Chatterboxes?

parts.note: normally talkative people, but read literally as boxes in which people chatter

explanation.definitionFit: Public call boxes are booths where people go to talk, literally boxes for chatter.

clue.text: Quietly he accepts a pay increase, the hypocrite

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly

indicators.note: the pronoun takes in the following pieces, enclosing them

parts.note: a rise is a pay increase

explanation.surface: A man quietly takes a raise, showing his false virtue.
explanation.definitionFit: A Pharisee, from the sect criticised in the Gospels, has come to mean a self-righteous hypocrite.

clue.text: Weapon — injure about one thousand with it

indicators.note: the word for injure goes round the next pieces

parts.note: to scar is to injure, leaving a mark
I is the Roman numeral for one
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: Someone uses a weapon to wound a thousand people.
explanation.definitionFit: A scimitar is a curved oriental sword, a kind of weapon.

clue.text: Time to check the lines after casting?

definitions.text: Time to check the lines after casting?

parts.words: Time to check the lines after casting?
parts.note: suggests anglers inspecting fishing lines, but means actors running their script once the parts are assigned

explanation.surface: An angler checks the fishing line after a throw.
explanation.definitionFit: Once a play is cast, actors practise their lines at a run-through before performance.

clue.text: In direct opposition, before the guillotine's brought into action?

definitions.text: before the guillotine's brought into action?
definitions.meaning: humorously, the state of a victim's neck before the blade falls

explanation.definitionFit: Head-on means meeting directly face to face, and before beheading the victim still has the head attached.

clue.text: I had become attached to the Isle of Man in a manner of speaking

parts.note: I'd is the contraction of I had
IOM is the abbreviation for the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: Someone grew attached to the Isle of Man, so to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom is an expression peculiar to a language, a characteristic way of putting things.

clue.text: I'm not one to weaken

parts.note: taken as written without the apostrophe
a pair is two, so not one

explanation.surface: Someone declares they are not the sort to lose heart.
explanation.definitionFit: To impair is to damage or diminish strength, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Power at mains switch

indicators.note: the letters are switched around into a new order

explanation.surface: Electricity flows when the mains supply is switched on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Power' and 'mains switch' paint an electrical picture, but 'switch' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Stamina is staying power, endurance.

clue.text: Rifle fire

explanation.definitionFit: To sack is both to plunder a place and to dismiss someone from employment.

clue.text: Salesman is untruthful in his answers

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
lies means tells untruths

explanation.surface: A salesman tells lies when he responds.
explanation.definitionFit: Replies are responses, a plural noun synonym.

clue.text: Ill-considered break-out

definitions.meaning: an outbreak of spots on the skin

explanation.definitionFit: Rash means both recklessly hasty and an eruption of red spots on the skin.

clue.text: Elected to write article in French

definitions.meaning: the French word for a thing or item

explanation.walkthrough: 'to write' is a link: to write 'article' in French gives the French word for a thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Chose is the past tense of choose, picked, and is also the French for a thing or object.

clue.text: Reprimand, showing players one way out

parts.note: the cast is the set of players in a show
I is the Roman numeral for one
a gate is an exit

explanation.surface: The actors showing one route to the exit.
explanation.definitionFit: To castigate is to rebuke severely, a verb synonym.
